note: Every skill of assets/registry/monster_skills.json needs a line here (key: its name), or the site build fails.
Lunge: A quick piercing bite at an adjacent enemy.
Hamstring: A piercing bite at the legs that slows the target.
Ragged Bite: A tearing bite that makes the target bleed.
Howl: Hastes the wolf's own kin nearby.
Dirty Strike: A piercing stab that weakens the target.
Thrown Stone: A blunt stone thrown from range.
Net Throw: A net thrown from range that slows the target.
Spin Strike: A spinning blade strike at an adjacent enemy.
Leader: A passive aura that empowers the leader's kin around it.
Battle Cry: When struck, the warrior shouts and protects its kin.
Spark: A lightning bolt thrown from range.
Mending: Heals one of the shaman's kin.
Quicken: Hastes one of the shaman's kin.
